skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it.

Consumes all Contamination Gauge points. For each Contamination Gauge point consumed, applies 1 stack of Laceration to all enemies within a 3 tiles radius of self, pulls all enemies towards self by 2 tiles, deals AoE Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK, and applies Movement Failure for 1 turn.
Faye gains 8 tiles of Extra Movement and Shadow Step for 1 turn.
Increases Contamination Gauge by 2 points. Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius, applies 2 stacks of Laceration, and deals Physical damage equivalent to 120% ATK.

Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius, applies an equivalent number of stacks of Open Wounds as the number of stacks of Laceration held on all enemies within a 6 tile radius of self, and deals Physical damage equivalent to 160% ATK to the target.
If the target has 6 or more stacks of Laceration, consumes 6 stacks of Laceration and increases damage dealt by this attack by 120%.

When attacking, ignores 2% x number of stacks of Laceration of the enemy's DEF, and restores HP equivalent to 10% max HP + 2% x the number of stacks of Laceration.
At the end of the enemy's action, if the enemy is within a 6 tile radius of Faye, increases Contamination Gauge by 1 point, applies 1 stack of Laceration on the target, and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK and 2 Stability to it. If the enemy is within a 3 tile radius of Faye, increases Contamination Gauge by 1 point, applies 2 stacks of Laceration to all enemies within a 3 tile radius of self, and deals AoE Physical damage equivalent to 60% ATK and 1 Stability. This effect can be activated twice per round.
